g.aria-label: Managing Colab Image Drift & Driving Runtimes From the CLI
Colab updates default base images often
Dated images stay available for 1 year
Connecting to a past image takes 2–3 min
Lets local terminals & coding agents run
GPU tests without leaving the editor
Recommendation: Use latest runtime + pinned library versions for active development;
pin a dated runtime version when distributing fixed teaching material to hundreds of readers.
